about.heading: About Sheferoy Guppy
about.paragraph1: Sheferoy Guppy specialises in ornamental aquarium fish, including fancy guppies, colourful bettas, and selected breeding pairs. Our collection includes varieties with distinctive colours, patterns, and fin shapes for aquarium enthusiasts and fish breeders.
about.paragraph2: Contact us to learn about current fish availability, pricing, breeding pair options, and the varieties that best suit your interests.

seo.heading: Explore Guppies, Bettas and Breeding Pairs
seo.subheading: Learn more about the distinctive characteristics and requirements of each ornamental variety.

fancyGuppies.text: Fancy guppies are celebrated for their colourful patterns, energetic swimming behaviour, and diversity of finnage. Tail shapes range from wide delta tails and delicate veiltails to oversized dumbo ear pectorals. Their calm nature, peaceful temperament, and iridescent coloration make ornamental guppies one of the most popular choices for planted community tanks.
fancyGuppies.title: Fancy Guppies

bettaFish.text: Ornamental betta fish (Betta splendens) are known for their bold individual personalities, rich pigmentation, and striking fin varieties. Our collection showcases impressive forms such as 180-degree halfmoons, intricate rosetails, and active plakats in vivid solid, dragon scale, and tricolor patterns.
bettaFish.title: Betta Fish

breedingPairs.text: For hobbyists and dedicated breeders aiming to maintain consistent line genetics, selected guppy breeding pairs are an ideal starting point. Customers can enquire directly with us regarding pair availability, verified sex identification, strain traits, and current pricing before placing an order.
